$comment: GaaS platform sheet for `gaas new` → `casals sheet deploy`. Conductor canisters (casals_backend, casals_frontend, casals_file_registry) are created by `casals new`, not this sheet. Registry vs installer are separate stands (same-stand backend+frontend on a lumped platform stand tripped ManagePermissions). infra-baton is minted here (top_commander $self). Deployments commander (the installer principal) is applied after mint via set_commander — sheet commanders need a concrete principal and $self is not expanded there. realm_registry_frontend is DNS adopt-only (test.gos.earth): register_canister with the same name, then deploy_sheet reconciles by name. Product marketplace / file_registry live in the Realms repo casals.json. Realm stands are created later by the installer into Deployments.
name: gaas
description: GaaS *.gos.earth platform: governance, infra baton, installer, realm registry. Deployments start empty.

sections.name: Infra
sections.description: Orchestration governance (multisig + infra baton) and GaaS portal canisters (installer, realm registry).

stands.name: governance
stands.description: Root multisig for platform and baton IC control. Signers configured post-deploy.

stands.name: orchestration
stands.description: Infra baton: managed-upgrade governance for installer and realm-registry. Top commander: this Casals backend.

stands.name: installer
stands.description: Realm installer backend. Granted Deployments section commander after mint.

stands.name: realm-registry
stands.description: Realm registry backend and DNS-mapped frontend (test.gos.earth adopt-by-name).

sections.name: Deployments
sections.description: Realm stands (one per realm; created by realm_installer at provision time). Installer is granted section commander after sheet deploy — the principal is the installer canister ID, unknown when this file is written.
